title: Black metal knife

infobox.Crafting Materials: Black metal x12, Linen thread x15

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Black metal knife is the fifth knife. Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its secondary attack is a forward leap with 3x damage.
It deals 6x damage against unalerted enemies.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The secondary attack can be extraordinarily powerful if the player is sneaky and attacks a creature while it is unalerted.

Black metal knife

Internal ID: KnifeBlackMetal | Type: Knife | Source: Forge | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Black metal x12, Linen thread x15 | Attack speed: 1.52 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 1.8 range, 45 angle, 0.5 height, 0.3 ray

Introduction. The Black metal knife is the fifth knife. Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its secondary attack is a forward leap with 3x damage.
It deals 6x damage against unalerted enemies.

Notes. • The secondary attack can be extraordinarily powerful if the player is sneaky and attacks a creature while it is unalerted.
